d: The Officer Customer Care Agent is responsible for delivering exceptional customer service by handling customer inquiries, requests, complaints, and feedback through various communication channels, including phone calls, email, chat, social media, and customer care systems. The role holder is responsible for resolving customer issues efficiently, providing accurate information, and ensuring a positive customer experience while meeting service quality and operational performance standards.
Handle inbound and outbound customer interactions across all approved communication channels.
Respond to customer inquiries, requests, complaints, and feedback in a professional and timely manner.

Identify and escalate complex or sensitive customer issues to the appropriate teams.

Ability to handle difficult customer situations professionally.
Fluency in Arabic and English is preferred.
